CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetK2ServerDocCount

Returns the total number of documents in all the collections served by the Verity K2 Server. Compare it with GetK2ServerDocCountLimit to see how close the server is to its licensed limit.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetK2ServerDocCount()

Returns

An integer; 0 when the K2 Server is offline.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Used = GetK2ServerDocCount()>
<CFSET Limit = GetK2ServerDocCountLimit()>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>#NumberFormat(Used)# of #NumberFormat(Limit)# documents indexed
(#DecimalFormat(Used * 100 / Limit)#% of the limit).</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetK2ServerDocCountLimit, IsK2ServerDocCountExceeded, CFINDEX
